settings.caption: #9 Prospect in 2028 Class (Pitcher & First Base)
settings.heading: I Became A Believer Instantly…I Highly Recommend The SPINGRIP
settings.text:
I became a believer instantly. This product feels great in the hand and is incredibly comfortable for training. The SpinGrip allows me to focus on feeling the ball in my fingers rather than deep in my hand, which can cause restrictions in movement. It also helps me stay behind the ball, maximizing spin while reducing unnecessary tension.
I highly recommend the SpinGrip to anyone looking to refine their skills. It’s a tool I’ll continue to use and trust in my training.

settings.title: The “Fear” of Throwing for Years Gradually Disappeared
settings.text:
"I played baseball for 12 years, battled the yips for the last 4 years. Lost all my confidence in throwing. After training with the SPINGRIP, I could feel the "fear" of throwing gradually disappear and I experienced that free release of the ball again.”

- Sam

settings.title: Kids Choke the Ball All the Time…This Tool is Vital
settings.text:
"I coach youth baseball and see kids choking the ball all the time. This tool is vital for a healthy development of a thrower.”

- Nick

settings.title: Was Skeptical…But After Throwing with SPINGRIP…I was Completely Amazed
settings.text:
I understood the principle behind SpinGrip, but was skeptical as to how it would actually perform. 

After throwing with SPINGRIP for 15 minutes and then throwing without it, I was completely amazed at the difference.

When I gripped the ball, it felt right to hold it away from my palm and toward my fingertips. On my release, the ball came out smoother and with more rotation — and with less effort. By holding the ball correctly, my wrist and elbow and shoulder felt like they were all in sync.

- Ashley

settings.title: Helped Me Get a Higher and More Consistent Spinrate
settings.text:
“It helped me easily get the ball in my finger tips to where I didn't have to think about it, and helped me get a higher and more consistent spin rate than normal”

- Matthew
